QUALITY DEFECT COMPLAINT REPORT
Customer: ABC Pharma International
Product: Paracetamol API Grade
Strength: 99.5% USP
Batch Number: PA240812
Manufacturing Date: 12 August 2026
Expiry Date: August 2028
Affected Quantity: 25 kg in 1 fiber drum
Incident Description: Quality inspection noted visible black particulate contamination on surface layer.

PACKAGING DEVIATION NOTIFICATION
Customer Name: BioHealth Distribution
Product: Amoxicillin Trihydrate 500mg
Batch: AMX-2026-884
Quantity Compromised: 350 cartons
Observations: Crushed cartons with intact inner foil blisters.

Certificate of Analysis Retest Failure
Customer: Nordic Care Pharmaceuticals
Product: Ibuprofen DC 90%
Lot: IBU-DC-9011
Assay Result: 72.4% (Specification: 98.0% - 102.0%)
Total Lot Volume Quarantined: 1200 kg.

From: qa-team@apexlabs.com
To: complaints@aivoa.com
Date: 17 Aug 2026
Subject: Yellow discoloration in Metformin HCl

Dear QA Team,
We observed slight yellowing in Metformin HCl batch MET-850-2026 (80 kg). Please initiate deviation.

URGENT RECALL ALERT
Product: Ciprofloxacin Infusion 200mg/100ml
Batch Number: CIP-STER-099
Affected Quantity: 450 vials
Defect: Positive microbial growth in 14-day sterility test.

Physical Inspection Report
Product: Aspirin 100mg Tablets
Batch: ASP-2026-01
Quantity: 50 boxes
Issue: Chipped tablet edges in blister cavities.

Logistics Quality Audit
Customer: Global Health Labs
Product: Azithromycin 250mg
Lot: AZI-901
Affected: 15 kg
Condition: Loose tamper-evident closure.

From: complaints@meridianlabs.com
Subject: Batch Rejection - Capping
Product: Metformin HCl 500mg
Batch: MET-500-A
Quantity: 10000 tablets
Defect: Severe tablet capping on compression line.

Hospital Pharmacovigilance Report
Customer: St. Jude Hospital
Product: Ciprofloxacin
Lot: CIP-GL-44
Quantity: 120 vials
Defect: Glass shard observed floating in sterile solution.

Packaging Line Inspection
Customer: Allied Care
Product: Amoxicillin Trihydrate
Batch: AMX-LBL-12
Quantity: 600 cartons
Defect: Barcode unreadable by warehouse handheld scanner.
